Hi Alyssa —

Great to talk — appreciate the clear requirements. Per your list below, I'm attaching our standard vendor packet and W-9.

Quick answers:
- We support both card and PO-based procurement. Card payments are fine for cards/credit limits; for PO+invoice we offer Net 30 by default (we can negotiate Net 45/60 for enterprise deals with a signed SOW).
- AWS Marketplace: we are listed and can offer procurement via Marketplace (we can provide marketplace SKUs and pricing cadence if you want to go that route).
- Timeline: vendor setup is typically 3-5 business days once we receive a completed intake form + W-9 and banking details. If you need SCC/contract redlines, add 3-10 business days depending on legal review.

Next steps (suggested):
1) I attach our Redwood Vendor Packet (PDF) and W-9.
2) If you can complete the attached procurement intake form (questions included) and confirm PO vs card, we will kick off vendor setup.
3) If you prefer Marketplace, tell me and I can send the marketplace order details and a dedicated SKU.

I copied Marissa (our procurement lead) who will own the setup once we have your completed intake form.

Best,
